name: 32003 · Fleming Isle, FL
findings: ZIP 32003 (Fleming Isle) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32003 (Fleming Isle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32003 (Fleming Isle) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
